sanitization: Public excerpts were sanitized again in memory; identifiers/names/contact/location/URLs replaced. All data URLs use example.invalid. Synthetic provenance is explicit. No account credentials or media downloaded.

public_owner_account.json.purpose: Owner account shape selected by the upstream ME query; telemetry is sample data, not verified working sensors.

public_postcard_analysis.json.purpose: Modern analysis result with five images, one video and recognized preview species. Structure and media cardinality retained.

public_collected_partial.json.purpose: Deliberately partial public collected result: eleven assets have IDs/types only. Tests must not assume content URLs or timestamps are present.

public_collection.json.purpose: Account collection cover metadata; feederName is selected but explicit feeder ID is not.

account_owner_hardware.json.purpose: Owner with newer hardware and nullable telemetry; V2_NOOK is schema-recognized, not hardware-tested.

account_member_pending.json.purpose: Member and pending roles; member lacks owner-only settings and metrics may be null.

account_empty.json.purpose: Authenticated account with zero feeders; does not prescribe current setup failure.

accounts_shared_feeder.json.purpose: Two accounts share one physical feeder while the second also owns another; explicit routing must not depend on list order.

postcard_complete.json.purpose: Full selected-shape card with explicit feeder, two images and video; use for event/share/media preservation.

postcard_unrecognized.json.purpose: A HIGH_CONFIDENCE card can have no recognized species; inference flag is not evidence of a bird.

postcard_video_only.json.purpose: Video-only card: future normalizer and events must not silently drop the sole asset.

postcard_collected_complete.json.purpose: Full selected-shape collected card with multiple species and mixed media; distinct from the partial public result.

feed_variants.json.purpose: Nested collection.species, singular/plural media, explicit collection feeder attribution, mystery/null and new/collected variants.

feed_empty.json.purpose: Empty feed with terminal cursor; no max(empty) or missing-list assumptions.

feed_postcard_minimal.json.purpose: Routine upstream FEED selects only ID/time/type for NewPostcard; absence of media is not proof the API has none.

feed_incremental_pages.json.purpose: Two pages with overlap and equal timestamps for cursor/deduplication/retry tests; small page size is deliberate.

feed_malformed_timestamp.json.purpose: Selected non-null createdAt is intentionally null to exercise backend/schema-drift tolerance.

feed_unknown_type.json.purpose: Invented future union member; intentionally outside current schema to test graceful unknown-type handling.

media_expired.json.purpose: Known expired placeholder URL for cache invalidation; no downloaded bytes or actual credentials.

postcard_long_urls.json.purpose: Large but schema-valid mixed-media card above32KiB; padding is harmless placeholder text, not an actual signature.
